dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The prominent structures exhibit irregular, amoeboid 'O' and 'C' shapes with jagged, high-intensity perimeters. There is a sharp contrast gradient between the dark background and the bright white borders, with a mid-tone grey interior filling.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid, high-intensity white clusters. Notable instances are localized on the distal portion of the hind flipper and sparsely scattered between the larger annuli on the lateral-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the upper right quadrant form a wide-angled obtuse triangle. A secondary, nearly linear relationship is formed by two high-intensity blobs on the lower flipper region relative to the nearest large annulus centroid.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-intensity alphanumeric characters ('EF / WW') is superimposed on the upper right edge of the subject's dorsal silhouette.
